screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Policy v13 operator release of crown-v197 v1, exact SHA b4da5c80...86699d9, attempt e4dee43f. Hold was l3-adjudicator-model-step-budget with no verified finding (the private adjudicator ran out of steps; seed envelope 41 MiB of 8192 MiB). The earlier l2-late-result attempt was a screener provider fault, not the miner's. Base: publicly released dan0l v30 (95534e25, SHA 29cf12e6...), published 2026-10-31T00:41Z, before this 2026-11-01T12:23Z upload (publication_proven_by_reference_time=true) and declared in DECLARATION.md:9. 35 files: 21 byte-identical to v30, 14 modified, none added. uc3 unreleased-copy is not flagged (top score 1, released base excluded). app/guide_records.py, the target of nearly all L1 I5 notes (lines 25/27/128), is byte-identical to released v30. Its routed notes reach the deciding model only as advisory text, under the 2026-10-23 routed-guidance clarification, the same holding as crown-v190/v194/v195. Answer authority: agent.py:185 returns plain_type(outcome.content), and answer.py and typography.py are identical to v30. Every outcome.content write is model text (action.py:650,702; records.py:549,555,571,576,627), and the records.py:635 fallback is the model's own pre-deliberation draft, as in v192/v194. No host compare, retry-until-match, rebuild or substitution exists, and v193's echo-reject/rebuild path is absent. Deltas vs v30: short.py:62 SHARED_DRAFT_NOTE asks the model to keep the shared draft unless a note contradicts it. That is prompt text only, under the reused-draft clarification (PR #3270/#3281, crown-v194 ruling). short.py:173 skips the advisory final check and passes asked_part as input when a draft exists; no host override follows. records.py: prompt wording, all search-pass notes shown together, and the compose_listing record index (records.py:117-127,472-476) used in place of the full log for long packets, with find_in_records still offered. finder.py: default effective-step ordering, with each part labelled by a number it already carries (content unchanged). action.py: NEAR_TOOL_NOTE rejection hint, with the call still not sent (action.py:668-669); the whole catalog is kept for setting checks; prompt sentences. request_kinds.py, lane.py and route.py: one-edit and typo-tolerant routing patterns that choose notes and lanes, with the whole catalog still offered. tools.py: UNDELIVERED_NOTE wording on a non-delivery that stays NOT_DELIVERED/DELIVERED_FAILED (tools.py:154,196-200), so I6 is not established. llm.py: a channel-marker trim on tool names and a no-break-space fold (request-independent W8), and DITTOBENCH_PROMPT_LOG is unset in the image. agent.py: the own-topic lane changes only the prompt and packet, and logging adds a text hash. deliberation.py and guide_tools.py: prompt text. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground found. Static diff review only; exact UUID only.
